subject: Life-Threatening Allergies Policy Revision
overview: The subcommittee reviewed a draft policy for managing life-threatening allergies, focusing on improving its structure and ensuring clarity for staff and families. Members decided to separate high-level policy statements from operational guidance to allow for easier implementation and updates.

items.title: Management of Life-Threatening Allergies Policy
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed a 24-page draft policy covering student safety, staff roles, and requirements for school-affiliated groups like PTOs and athletic teams. Members reached a consensus to split the document into a concise formal policy and a separate guidance manual to improve usability and compliance across the district.

items.title: Review of Policy Sections and Next Steps
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed specific document sections to determine which elements, such as allergy triggers and cafeteria strategies, should remain in the formal policy versus the guidance manual. Approved a motion to have the administration and the chair rework the proposal to reflect these structural changes before the next meeting.
